description: This PHP script manages the overview of requirements in the TestLink project, including rendering a table of requirements, monitoring status, and handling user interactions such as toggling monitoring states. It initializes page data, fetches requirement information, constructs a dynamic table with grouping and sorting features, and manages user rights.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Represents an external class used for rendering extended tables with grouping, sorting, and toolbar features.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates user input arguments related to the project and requirements.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI data including page titles, requirement IDs, and project name for rendering.

methods.name: getCfg
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings such as character set, date formats, and custom labels.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Loads and returns labels for different UI elements based on requirement configurations.

methods.name: buildOnClick
methods.description: Builds JavaScript action links for toggling monitoring on requirements.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for access to requirement monitoring features.
